name: Toepen
summary: Dutch 4-card trick-taking game where players avoid penalty points by winning the last trick and may raise the stakes by knocking.
rules_text: Each player starts with 10 lives. From a 32-card deck (10 high, 9, 8, 7, A, K, Q, J) deal 4 cards each. A player whose hand is all J/Q/K/A may discard and draw a new hand; any discard can be challenged - challenger loses a life if discard was legal, otherwise discarder loses a life. Play 4 tricks: lead suit must be followed if possible, highest card of led suit wins trick, winner leads next. Winner of the 4th trick wins the hand and deals next. All other players lose points equal to the current hand value (starts at 1). Anyone may toep (knock) at any time to increase hand value by 1. After a toep each opponent must fold (take previous value in points) or stay (risk new value). A player on 9 lives may not make the first toep, on 8 lives not the second, etc. A player on pelt (one from elimination at 10 or 15) leads first and hand starts at 2; others may leave for 1 before play. First to reach max lives is out; last remaining wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking for 3-8, drinking variant implies bluffing/bidding.
